verdict.rationale: Bruno AI is built into the app. It offers ghost-text suggestions in script editors, AI generation of scripts, tests and docs, and an AI Chat Sidebar for questions from anywhere in the workspace. It also understands the context of the open request or collection, so its suggestions are grounded in the user's own data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI analysing response data to surface insights such as anomalies or patterns, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
